exposure: wound characteristics (Additional treatment, Serous discharge, Erythema, Purulent discharge, Separation of deep tissues, Superficial separation of tissues, Isolation of bacteria, duration of in-patient Stay, secondary surgical wound closure)
outcome: modified ASEPSIS score (quality of wound healing)
need for secondary surgical wound closure
cohort: 132 pregnant women who underwent delivery via Cesarean section.
finding: Wound dehiscence significantly influenced the modified ASEPSIS score and was associated with a significantly prolonged hospital stay.
